questions.q: Under the Fire Code, panic hardware is mounted between about 760 mm and 1,120 mm. Which height is out of range?
questions.n: 1,250 mm is above the allowed band.

questions.q: The accessible shower type that lets a wheelchair roll straight in is a:
questions.n: No curb, so it's level entry.

questions.q: For a commercial space inside the building to count as a minor accessory occupancy, it may take up no more than:
questions.n: Above 10% it's treated as a mixed occupancy.

questions.q: An unoccupied open space enclosed by building walls or yards is a:
questions.n: Courts give light and air to inner rooms.

questions.q: Minimum clear width of an accessible corridor under BP 344:
questions.n: 1.20 m is the minimum.

questions.q: Building bulk is mainly controlled by:
questions.n: FLAR fixes how much floor area a lot may carry.

questions.q: The report of plans, specs and design analysis by the engineer or architect of record and the fire safety practitioner is the:
questions.n: Submitted during plan evaluation.

questions.q: The turnover compilation of approved submittals and acceptance tests of all fire protection features is the:
o: FSCCR (Fire Safety Compliance and Commissioning Report)
questions.n: Part of the as-built documents.

questions.q: Accessible parking stall width under BP 344:
questions.n: Wider to allow a wheelchair transfer.

questions.q: Wheelchair turning space in an accessible toilet should be at least:
questions.n: A 1.5 m turning circle is the BP 344 standard.

questions.q: An architect filing a building permit for the owner needs:
o: A notarized special power of attorney
questions.n: The SPA authorizes acting for the owner.

questions.q: Written covenants limiting how lots in a neighborhood may be used are:
questions.n: Developers attach them to titles.

questions.q: Under BP 344, a narrow corridor needs wheelchair turning space at intervals of not more than:
questions.n: A turning space at least every 12 m.

questions.q: Minimum headroom under and above a mezzanine floor:
questions.n: The NBC allows 1.8 m clear for mezzanines.

questions.q: A typical prohibition in subdivision deed restrictions:
o: Repainting the exterior in another color
Splitting a lot into two residential units
questions.n: Restrictions keep the planned density.

questions.q: Yard width under the building code is measured from the:
o: Outermost face of the building to the property line
Outermost projection to the property line
Face of the building to the curb
questions.n: Projections like eaves don't count as the face.

questions.q: After final inspection and the Certificate of Completion, the Building Official issues the Certificate of Occupancy within:
questions.n: NBC Sec. 309.

questions.q: A building permit lapses if work is suspended or abandoned for:
questions.n: NBC Sec. 207: one year without starting, or 120 days suspended.

questions.q: BP 344 sets sidewalks at 1.50 m minimum. Where two wheelchairs must pass, widen to:
questions.n: 1.80 m lets two chairs pass.

questions.q: A lot fronting a public street on one side and alleys on two other sides is a:
questions.n: It combines corner and through conditions.

questions.q: Inner, open and through are types of:
questions.n: Courts are classified by how they're enclosed.

questions.q: The Fire Code (RA 9514) is administered and enforced by the:
questions.n: The BFP under DILG enforces it.

questions.q: "PS" stamped on a mohon boundary marker means:
questions.n: It marks a privately surveyed corner.

questions.q: A traditional bahay kubo of bamboo, wood and nipa is which NBC construction type?
questions.n: Type I is wood construction; Type V is fully fire-resistive.

questions.q: Under the NBC, Type V construction is:
o: Fire-resistive: steel, iron, concrete or masonry, with incombustible walls and ceilings
questions.n: Type V is the most fire-resistive.

questions.q: The PRC Modernization Act of 2000 is:
questions.n: It reorganized the Professional Regulation Commission.

questions.q: The owner's compilation of maintenance and test records for fire systems, needed for FSIC renewals, is the:
questions.n: Kept by building engineering and maintenance.

questions.q: Deep wells are primarily governed by the:
questions.n: Water rights and extraction fall under the Water Code (PD 1067).

questions.q: Which agency accredits construction materials testing laboratories?
questions.n: DPWH's Bureau of Research and Standards accredits materials labs.

questions.q: Regulations controlling how a lot may be used and built on are called:
questions.n: Setbacks, FLAR and ISA are development controls.

questions.q: Under NBC Sec. 805, habitable rooms with artificial ventilation need a ceiling height of at least:
questions.n: Naturally ventilated rooms need 2.70 m; artificially ventilated ones 2.40 m.

questions.q: Fire Safety Compliance and Maintenance Reports (FSCR, FSCCR, FSMR) are prepared and certified by a:
questions.n: The RIRR of RA 9514 assigns these reports to accredited fire safety practitioners.

questions.q: Exit enclosures in a seven-storey building need walls rated at least:
questions.n: Four or more storeys: 2-hour exit enclosures.

questions.q: A one-family dwelling surrounded on all sides by open space on its own lot is:
questions.n: It shares no walls.

questions.q: PUD in zoning stands for:
questions.n: A PUD is planned as one integrated whole.

questions.q: "Economic and socialized housing standards" distinct from PD 957 were authorized by:
questions.n: BP 220 sets lower standards for economic and socialized housing.

questions.q: Environmental noise limits are set by the:
questions.n: DENR's Environmental Management Bureau sets ambient standards.

questions.q: A zoning certificate is requested from the:
o: City/Municipal Planning and Development Office (zoning office)
questions.n: The zoning administrator under the CPDO issues locational clearance.

questions.q: A wall with no openings at all is a:
questions.n: Blank walls without windows or doors are dead walls.

questions.q: Height clearance permits near airports are issued by:
questions.n: The Civil Aviation Authority of the Philippines.

questions.q: Minimum clear headroom over a stairway:
questions.n: Measured vertically from the tread nosing line.
